name: Yoshimura
source:
A Divine Sword wielder.

Together with Morita, Yoshimura is a part of the village's senior squad. They were already fighting the Ayakashi as early as 1923. 

She is over a century old, but thanks to the Divine Sword's effects, her aging has been significantly slowed down. As such, she still wields immense power and is able to go toe to toe with the kitsune.

[spoiler]A long time ago, she fought alongside Utano, the previous wielder of Len's Divine Sword. She still detests the kitsune who took her comrade's life.[/spoiler]

[Based on [url=https://k-yomiji.sakura.ne.jp/kyouhime/#a_chara]two[/url] separate [url=https://k-yomiji.sakura.ne.jp/kyouhime2/#a_chara]descriptions[/url] provided by the author.]
